Three more people died of dengue in the last 24 hours, bringing the total death toll for the year to 43, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

A total of 458 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country during the same period.

Of the new admissions, Dhaka division saw 172 patients, followed by Barishal with 99, Chattogram with 78, Khulna 48, Rajshahi 26, Mymensingh 25, and Rangpur 10.

The three recent deaths occurred in Dhaka, Khulna, and Barishal divisions.

Currently, 1,118 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in various hospitals, with 251 in Dhaka and 869 outside the capital.

Since January 1, 2024, a total of 13,098 dengue patients have been hospitalized and 43 people have died.

headline: Soumya and Jaker return as Bangladesh name 15-member squad for Australia Test
summary: Opener Soumya Sarkar returns to the Test fold after four years, while pacer Mushfik Hasan earns his maiden call-up for the series starting August 13.
details: Bangladesh has announced a 15-member squad for the two-match Test series against Australia, with the first match scheduled for August 13 at the Marrara Cricket Ground in Darwin.

Opener Soumya Sarkar returns to the Test setup after more than four years, having last played against the West Indies in February 2021. Wicketkeeper-batter Jaker Ali also returns to the squad to bolster the lower middle order.
Pacer Mushfik Hasan has earned a place in the squad, while right-handed batter Amite Hasan retains his spot following his debut during the recent tour of Zimbabwe.

The squad faces several absences, with opener Mahmudul Hasan Joy and batter Tawhid Hridoy left out. The pace attack is also missing young quick Nahid Rana and regular seamer Shoriful Islam due to injuries.
The Tigers will depart for Australia on July 31 and will play a three-day practice match against a Cricket Australia XI from August 6-8 at the DXC Arena in Darwin.
The second Test of the series is set to begin on August 21 at the Great Barrier Reef Arena in Mackay.
caption:
Soumya Sarkar returns to Test cricket after 4 years! 🇧🇩

Bangladesh has named its 15-member squad for the upcoming series against Australia.

Bangladesh has announced a 15-member squad for the two-match Test series against Australia, with the first match scheduled for August 13 at the Marrara Cricket Ground in Darwin.

Opener Soumya Sarkar returns to the Test setup after more than four years, having last played against the West Indies in February 2021. Wicketkeeper-batter Jaker Ali also returns to the squad to bolster the lower middle order.

Pacer Mushfik Hasan has earned a place in the squad, while right-handed batter Amite Hasan retains his spot following his debut during the recent tour of Zimbabwe.

The squad faces several absences, with opener Mahmudul Hasan Joy and batter Tawhid Hridoy left out. The pace attack is also missing young quick Nahid Rana and regular seamer Shoriful Islam due to injuries.

The Tigers will depart for Australia on July 31 and will play a three-day practice match against a Cricket Australia XI from August 6-8 at the DXC Arena in Darwin.

The second Test of the series is set to begin on August 21 at the Great Barrier Reef Arena in Mackay.
